inspectedText: Article reports Hughes and Knight arrived from Macon to seize William and Ellen under FugitiveSlaveLaw and return them to slavery. Arrest warrants and local protection efforts described. Supports actual recapture threat in Boston1850. Original printed page174 inspected.
